profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Valon
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Dave, a tech consultant specializing in finance and banking based in New York City.

With a multifaceted skill set encompassing software engineering, management consulting, and sales expertise, I aim to leverage technology to tackle complex business challenges and drive impactful solutions for clients.

In my free time, I enjoy biking around the city, reading, and exploring New York with friends.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack engineer on a React + Python start-up stack.
- Collaborated, designed, and engineered the client-facing experience for the company product for external vendors for a multi-tenant architecture end-to-end. Researched and leveraged industry best practices to achieve a proper level of abstraction and scalability.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Specialization in Regulatory Reporting under Finance and Banking, with a focus on Process Automation leveraging Software/AI Engineering
- FR Y-9C, Call Report (FFIEC 031), FR Y-15, etc.
- Software implementation, Data lineage & requirements mapping, Process automation (Python, Gen AI)
- Able to fully leverage key softwares in reg reporting space: Axiom SL/Adenza, Oracle (OFSAA), Reg Reporter, etc.
- Full stack web app development with React frontend and Java backend and other integrations (Kafka, MongoDB, OAuth, Swagger, etc.)

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
Full stack engineer for Scope's service platform.
- Engineered various frontend and backend features for the service platform web app using Vue.js, PrimeFaces, Tailwind, and Node.js.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Published an accepted paper to IEEE HRI 2024 as second author.
- Prototyped a robotic assistive bathing system for disabled & elderly people. Features include a force-position controller for the robot arm and a transformer neural network segmentation model for RGBD + thermal camera data of the human body.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Graduate TA for INFO 2300: Intermediate Web Design & Programming. Weekly tasks included leading discussion and office hours, managing team of 20+ undergraduate TAs, and grading.

Other TA positions included the following courses:
- CS 4780: Machine Learning
- CS 3110: Functional Programming & Data Structures
- ECE 2300: Digital Logic & Computer Organization
- ECE 1210: Smartphone Technology
- PHYS 1112: Mechanics & Heat

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
- Led and managed the Data Engineering team for Cornell Data Science, a competitive project team of 100+ students.
- Developed Cypria (new programming language) and built a site to demo the language.
- Implemented MyCourseIndex (course material index) with a team of 20+, used across 4 Cornell computer science classes with 1,000+ students.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Contributed a method to compute partial convolutions of CNNs for image data with PyTorch.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering

volunteerExperiences.description: Served as president of the college ministry of the Korean Church at Cornell.
Attained the highest rank of Eagle Scout in the Boy Scouts of America in Spring 2017.
